title: Эльф · печати и детали
prompt:
One 1536x1024 sheet of SIX independent equal square fantasy card illustrations in a strict 3 column by 2 row contact sheet, exact thirds and half thin straight black gutters. No text, no UI, no letters or numbers. Same hand-crafted crisp true pixel-art look on about a 128x128 logical grid per tile enlarged nearest neighbor, solid pixel clusters, no anti-aliasing, only deliberate dithering. 24–32 distinct colors per tile maximum, a few shades per hue; use the palette and daylight indicated for each scene. Across the sheet make scenes deliberately different in light and hue, including brighter warm scenes, water-blue, moss-green, violet and terracotta. Keep strong thumbnail-readable silhouettes and one clear focal object per tile, one clear light source. Full bleed independent compositions, key detail in upper two-thirds, no borders except straight black separators. Empty scenes with NO people, no hands. Every object illustrated as non-action museum/fantasy props and ordinary scenery, no injuries. Grounded perspective and believable shapes. Row-major order:
TOP LEFT: small violet wax seal with a crescent pictogram and a sage branch on warm peach workshop linen, bright afternoon.
TOP MIDDLE: pale gold sun-shaped metal ornament around a milky amber stone on white sandstone, cheerful golden daylight.
TOP RIGHT: polished charcoal-and-indigo obsidian ornament with a crescent silhouette on claret velvet, one lilac backlight.
BOTTOM LEFT: circular prism medallion, one sunlit cream side and one periwinkle shaded side, salmon stone below, teal edge.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: single ornate leather-wrapped fantasy prop grip with brass cap, amber and maroon on a light pine display board.
BOTTOM RIGHT: wing-shaped golden decorative brass crosspiece on muted burgundy cloth, diagonal warm sunlight, small silver screw caps.

The bare straight piece lies neatly diagonally on rust-red linen on a carpenter's table in strong pink dawn sunlight, edges reflect a little gold. Main subject simple, realistic drawing, easily legible at card thumbnail. Quiet decorative fantasy artisan exhibit, entirely stationary, no characters or hands. Deep burgundy, pale pink, ivory silver, small ochre accents, restricted palette, crisp visible square pixel art 128x128 logical grid enlarged nearest-neighbor. No anti-aliasing, no letters, no diagrams, no UI, no frame, no text.
